<!-- 1. Mount Hook --> <on_mount action="XHR"> <url>https://api.example.com/feed</url> <target>data.feed</target> </on_mount>
<!-- 2. Recurring Interval Hook --> <on_interval ms="1000" action="SET_STATE"> <path>data.seconds</path> <value>{data.seconds + 1}</value> </on_interval>
<!-- 3. State Change Watcher Hook --> <on_state_change watch="data.counter" action="RUN_SCRIPT"> console.log("Counter updated to:", $data.counter); </on_state_change>

pre.code:
<actions> <action_def name="RegisterUser"> <param name="username" required="true" /> <param name="role" default="User" />
<step action="SET_STATE"> <path>data.user_name</path> <value>{args.username}</value> </step>
<step action="MUTATE_STATE" operation="PUSH"> <path>data.audit_log</path> <value message="Registered {args.username} ({args.role})" /> </step>
<return>{data.user_name}</return> </action_def> </actions>
<button class="btn-primary"> <on_click action="RegisterUser"> <arg name="username">Alice</arg> <arg name="role">Admin</arg> </on_click> Save Admin User </button>

pre.code:
<button class="btn-primary"> <on_click action="TRY"> <step action="XHR"> <url>https://api.example.com/submit</url> <method>POST</method> </step>
<catch var="err"> <step action="SET_STATE"> <path>data.error_message</path> <value>[{err.code}] {err.message} (Status: {err.status})</value> </step> </catch>
<finally> <step action="SET_STATE"> <path>data.is_loading</path> <value>false</value> </step> </finally> </on_click> Submit Form </button>

<button class="btn-primary"> <on_click action="TRY"> <retry attempts="3" delay="500" backoff="exponential" max_delay="3000"> <timeout ms="2000" message="Request timed out"> <step action="XHR"> <url>https://api.example.com/data</url> <target>data.items</target> </step> </timeout> </retry>
<delay ms="500" /> </on_click> Fetch Resiliently </button>

<data_model> <state id="firstName">Jane</state> <state id="lastName">Doe</state>
<computed id="fullName" deps="firstName, lastName"> return $data.firstName + " " + $data.lastName; </computed> </data_model>
<watch path="computed.fullName"> <step action="RUN_SCRIPT"> console.log("Full name updated:", $newValue); </step> </watch>
